name: News cards are accessible without excessive scrolling
description: The Related News panel content should be reachable within reasonable scroll distance after clicking the News tab, not buried at the very bottom of a long page.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match to open a match detail page
Scroll down once or twice to bring the news section into view

Verify that at least one news card is visible after clicking the News tab and scrolling down moderately. The news cards should be reachable within 2-3 screen scrolls from the match header, not require scrolling past the entire page.
